graph.name: Revise an emotional beat's pacing
graph.description:
Propose pacing edits around an existing emotional moment using a supplied rhythm reference.

Lesson: Rhythm gives an existing beat space through syntax while withholding invented feelings and events.

Limitations: Added sensations or thoughts are model proposals, not established facts; the example's base fixture changes rhythm only.

Opening makes this example the active workflow document. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Post: at most 1 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Change Rhythm to one flowing sentence and compare the envelope beat's pace.
Allow one observation already in a longer source while keeping the envelope unopened.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Before: He saw her name on the envelope and put it down unopened.

After: Her name on the envelope. He put it down. Still unopened.

Rhythm path: reply.out → breathe.in; pacing.out → breathe.reference; breathe → validate → review → apply. One Prose call.

Rhythm-only baseline: AllowedDetail is editorial reference text. This fixture permits syntax changes and no new sensation; no emotional-state detector is implied.

Unopened envelope · snapshot (reply)
Purpose: Freeze the latest completed text-only envelope beat.
Fixture: He saw her name on the envelope and put it down unopened. "Later," he said.
Inspect: See name → put envelope down unopened → say Later; motive is unsupplied.

A pause before the unopened letter (pacing)
Purpose: Supply a restrained rhythm-only reference.
Inspect: Cup example teaches pause placement, not a new object.

Give the envelope beat space (breathe)
Purpose: Give the unopened-envelope action space.
Inspect: Identify every edit as source-grounded wording or syntax.

Output tokens includes visible text and any reasoning tokens counted by the provider. A truncated result is discarded; inspect the error, then manually raise the cap and rerun. No automatic retry occurs.

Check envelope-beat permissions (validate)
Purpose: Validate envelope-beat narration patches.
Inspect: Check unchanged dialogue and protected envelope/unopened.

Review restraint at the pause (review)
Purpose: Require review of emotional restraint.
Inspect: Reject new psychology, tremors or an opened envelope.

Offer the slower envelope beat (apply)
Purpose: Offer the slower envelope beat.
Inspect: Full root Host result: compare the beat, then Apply or Reject.

sections.name: Rhythm
sections.text: Give recognition, putting down and unchanged condition distinct beats. A clear short fragment is allowed.

sections.name: Sample
sections.text: Original specimen: The cup at his place. He moved it aside. Still full.

sections.name: AllowedDetail
sections.text: Change syntax only. Reuse name, envelope and action. No new breath, tremor, sensation, memory, motive or elapsed time.

breathe.title: Style Transfer
breathe.instructions: Separate recognition and putting-down through syntax/sentence breaks only. Keep envelope unopened and Later speech exact. Add no reason, feeling, reaction or event.
